annotations.title: Recall verified memory and query the code/knowledge graph

description: Primary kage entry point. Validates memory health, recalls relevant packets, and queries both the code graph and knowledge graph — all in one call. Call this at the start of every task; it answers caller/usage questions from the code graph too, so you rarely need a separate graph tool.

changed_files.description: Optional changed files for pre-edit or PR risk context

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the project root

query.description: The task or question — used for both memory recall and code graph search

session_id.description: Optional active agent session id for memory reconciliation

targets.description: Optional files the agent may edit or explain; used for risk context

name: kage_context
